Name: Early Open Shops v1.2
Author: mmanlapat
Description:
[size=4]Allows 4 shops (Pierre, Robin, Marnie, Clint) to open early (7:00am).[/size]
[color=#cccccc]Pierre, Robin, Marnie and Clint now tends and open their shops at 7:00am.
After 9:00am (default opening time), they will follow their own vanilla schedule (if one still tends or leaves to do other activities).
Their vanilla routine is non-changed and will continue to follow their own schedule after 9:00am.
No other schedule is changed, just added 7:00am - 9:00am to tend their shops early.[/color]

[size=3][b]Notes:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b][size=2][color=#6fa8dc]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.2+[/color].[/size][/b]
[*]Please [b][color=#6fa8dc]ENDORSE[/color][/b] or [b][url=http://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_s-xclick&hosted_button_id=24NAGUZNEE4R8]Donate[/url][/b] if you like the mod. :D
[/list]

[/list]
